title: The before-and-after check: the site's side (Piece 3, P3-2)
why: decisions/0179 rule 2 and its note "Piece 3's decisions" (Jason, 2026-11-25: DB1 A, DB2 A, DB4 A, Staff Views yes; handoffs/piece3-check.md §3, §12). While the switch before_after is on, a release from git waits for its before look (GitHub's beforeafter.yml on staging, never live), goes on staging as before, and waits for the after look; its verdict joins its checks as "Before and after (advocates)": a pass goes on as before, a block withdraws it and puts the failure in the Work queue, an incomplete look or a spent day's budget waits for a person. No answer in an hour: asked again; in two: a Work queue ticket. Off (as shipped): everything is as today. The Staff Views advocate joins the Team.
data_reason: Adds one row to team_roster, once (only when it isn't there): the Staff Views advocate (Jason, 2026-11-25: "Staff Views yes"). Changes nothing else.

changes.what: The switch "The before-and-after check" (off until turned on)
A release's checks: Before and after (advocates); its waiting words
A blocked release's Audit ticket, and a late check's ticket
The Staff Views advocate on the Team page
FAQ: What is the before-and-after check? and the Team page's answer (34 roles)

checks.switch_off_unchanged: With before_after off (as shipped), begin() answers nothing and Releases::fromGit stages and publishes exactly as before (pipeline.php).
checks.never_publishes_unchecked: A release waiting on the check is never staged-and-published without a verdict: late is asked again, then a Work queue ticket; an incomplete look and a spent budget wait for review (pipeline.php, 22 checks).

rollback: Proved on the bench (tools/team-tests/rollback.sh with PRE_MIGRATIONS = Piece 2's roster, 2026-11-25): the zip laid over the live mirror (Sync 2026-11-26 00:12 UTC) and its migration run twice (one row added once), then Roll back as the site does it: the files match live byte for byte, every PHP file parses, staging-tests/unit.php passes 65 on the rolled-back code. Left behind: the Staff Views advocate's row in team_roster (migrations only add; Put on standby retires it from the Team page).
